_comment: Shipped default source list — the one git-tracked file in config/ (public board slugs, no PII). Loaded by `ajoa-kit ingest` when the git-ignored config/seed.json is absent; copy + trim into config/seed.json for your own runs. Every `ats`/`feeds` entry is reachability-probed (no-auth tier-1 fetch) and ToS/ToU-vetted. The loader reads ONLY `feeds` + `ats`; `_blocked` (ToS/ToU-excluded) and `_deferred` (ToS-permitting but needs a JSON adapter the kit lacks) are documentation, never loaded. ToS/ToU tiering rationale + per-source findings: docs/decisions/0002-source-tos-tiers.md (ADR-0002).

aggregators.name: arbeitnow
aggregators._tos: Public job-board-api, robots-ALLOWED (200, x-ratelimit-limit:5); ToS §11 requires a backlink to arbeitnow.com — rendered in the dashboard footer (#11). Promoted from _deferred (#94, ADR-0002).

_blocked._reason: Our widget endpoint is undocumented + apply.workable.com robots.txt ai-train=no (a documented public jobs API exists, but third-party use is a grey zone with no explicit permission). Only ATS where HF resolves.
Public /api/offers is unauthenticated, but the separate API-Terms PDF (v2022.1.0) targets integration partners and could not be fully verified — exclude until reviewed.
Aggregator: API returns 200 with an in-payload notice requiring a follow backlink, but robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot/GPTBot and declares ai-train=no (AI-crawler-hostile) — exclude. See ADR-0002.
User Agreement bars scraping/automation + redistribution; robots.txt blocks job paths — paste only, never ingested.
Publisher API deprecated (301 to partners), RSS 404; ToS + robots.txt (/jobs, /api) bar automation — paste only.
No public read API (api.stepstone.com is inbound-only); ToS bars scraping; robots.txt disallows /public-api + parameterized URLs — paste only.
No public API/RSS (JobCloud); ToS bars crawlers/scrapers/automation; robots.txt disallows /api + detail pages — paste only.
Search surface, not a data source — no public candidate-side listings API; the only path is scraping SERPs, which violates Google ToS + robots.txt (Disallow: /search). See ADR-0002.

_deferred._note: Public JSON aggregators still pending a condition below (arbeitnow shipped in #94 under the loaded `aggregators` key). The loader reads only feeds/ats/aggregators; this block is documentation.

sources.name: jobicy
sources._tos: open API (ai-train=yes, full JD) BUT robots.txt Disallow:/api/ + no redistribution to other aggregators + asks <=~1 poll/hr — robots conflict, deferred (ADR-0002).

sources.name: himalayas
sources._tos: public /jobs/api returns 200 unauth, but general ToS §30 requires prior written approval for automated tools; no dedicated API-ToS grant (ADR-0002).

sources.name: remotive
sources._tos: robots.txt Disallow:/api/*; attribution (follow link + name) + <=4 req/day + 24h delay; private paid API for heavy use, no public price (ADR-0002).
